decision: Retain explicit directory attribution and core-only coverage. Do not claim a destination contract by selecting a neighboring pack or adding an identification-only manifest.
privacy: Public sources and authored synthetic boundary inputs only. No captured identifiers, payload values or signed tracking URLs are included.

sources.supported_scope: The guide publishes /v2/{advertiser}/{publisher} MMT and /vevent/{event}/{advertiser}/{publisher} UVP templates, with external-session guidance for UVP and CTV pixels.
sources.limitation: No /pixel.png endpoint, a payload encoding, advEntityId/pubEntityId query contract or Amazon collector mapping is published in this guide. Its UVP requiredness cannot establish required fields on /pixel.png.

sources.supported_scope: The producer maps proxy partner 37103 to https://vfw.amazon-adsystem.com/ias/ivt/j for configuration lookup. Runtime request bases are supplied by the retrieved configuration or verification parameters.
sources.limitation: The downloaded asset has no literal pixel.png constructor. The configuration relay and generic request code do not establish /ias/ivt/u/pixel.png or /ias/ivt/fw/rfw/.../skeleton.gif field requirements.

sources.supported_scope: An older public IAS runtime supplies generic monitoring and enrichment transport helpers.
sources.limitation: No literal pixel.png or /ias/ivt/ constructor. Does not document the new collector fields.

sources.supported_scope: The HTML5 API sends creative tracker and click messages to its parent, and includes the separately contracted legacy /imp fallback.
sources.limitation: No ft.stat literal or raw positional collector constructor. JavaScript tracker messages do not define the parent transport's field positions, requiredness, event enumeration, signatures or session semantics.

sources.supported_scope: Ad Verification Solutions identifies IAS, DoubleVerify and Adloox S2S integrations and instructs advertisers to obtain DSP-specific S2S measurement tags.
sources.limitation: The policy supplies no IAS collector URI, field table, payload encoding or per-request rejection contract. It cannot justify requiring the DV vstevt field on IAS hops.

remaining_requirements.needed_evidence: A vendor collector contract or attributable public producer that constructs these exact endpoints, including a encoding, conditional identifiers, session fields and proxy-specific requirements.
The parent collector producer or vendor transport specification for its semicolon tuple, event codes, integrity fields and request/session conditions.

checks: URL, VAST tracker and captured-request inputs expose directory.no_rulepack_coverage with the correct vendor and no selected vendor contract.
Opaque field values and positional tuples do not inherit unsupported sibling grammar or event enumerations.
Core GDPR errors and broken macro warnings remain active.
Existing /v2, /vevent, servedby /imp and Amazon DV event routes keep their own packs.
Host lookalikes receive no vendor attribution.
